# UULink

> UULink 让你用 iPhone 远程使用 Mac 上的 AI 编程助手，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、opencode、Qoder CLI、DeepSeek Harness、Pi 和 Antigravity，新建会话时选择。需要你决定时手机会收到通知，在手机上批准后任务继续。手机和 Mac 全程端到端加密，不经过 UULink 的服务器。
> UULink lets you use the coding agents on your Mac from your iPhone. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Qoder CLI, DeepSeek Harness, Pi and Antigravity; you choose one when you start a session. When a decision is needed your phone gets a notification, and the task continues once you approve on the phone. Your phone and Mac are end-to-end encrypted, and nothing goes through UULink's servers.

This file is written for coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex) that a user has asked to install UULink. Reply to the user in the language they used.

## Install on the Mac

Run these steps on the user's Mac. Stop and tell the user if a check fails.

1. Check requirements: `uname -m` must print `arm64` (Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported) and `sw_vers -productVersion` must be 14 or later.
2. Check that at least one supported agent is installed and signed in, for example `claude --version` (Claude Code) or `codex --version` (Codex) prints a version. UULink runs the user's own agents with their existing logins or API keys and charges nothing extra for them. The setup assistant detects Claude Code and Codex automatically; other agents (Cursor, opencode, Qoder CLI, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, Antigravity) are added later in UULink's Settings › Agent. Each agent must be installed by the user first; when one isn't detected, UULink shows how to install it and a link to its website. Per-agent instructions: https://uulink.pro/en/guide/agents/
3. Download and install the latest build:

   ```sh
   curl -fL -o /tmp/UULink.dmg https://nohup-web.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/download/mac/UULink-latest.dmg
   MNT=$(hdiutil attach /tmp/UULink.dmg -nobrowse | tail -1 | awk -F'\t' '{print $NF}')
   rm -rf /Applications/UULink.app && cp -R "$MNT/UULink.app" /Applications/
   hdiutil detach "$MNT" -quiet && rm /tmp/UULink.dmg
   open -a UULink
   ```

4. Tell the user: UULink opens a setup assistant (AI assistant → system permissions → control the desktop, optional → pair iPhone; it may ask for local network access — allow it so the phone can connect directly). The assistant ends with a pairing QR code. After that UULink lives in the menu bar; to show the code again, click the menu bar icon and choose "Pair New Device…" (「配对新设备…」).

## Install on the iPhone

The iPhone app is on the App Store: search for "UULink" or open https://apps.apple.com/app/id6819126745. Tell the user to open the app, tap "Scan Code to Add Mac" (「扫描二维码添加 Mac」) and scan the QR code on the Mac. A pairing code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once.

## Good to know

- The Mac must stay awake: UULink keeps it from idle sleep by default, but a closed laptop lid still puts it to sleep and the phone can't connect.
- New sessions are started on the iPhone, where the user picks which agent to use. Sessions started in the Mac terminal also show up for most agents.
- UULink is an independent tool, not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or any other agent provider. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic; other product names belong to their respective owners.
